slots.name: Action
slots.signature: ({ label, icon, priority, onSelect, disabled, menu, children }: import("./window-actions.js").WindowActionProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The action as it shows in the app bar: a ghost sm Button, a Segmented, a Menu trigger.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The More menu item is disabled.

props.name: icon
props.description: The item's icon in the More menu.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the action as an item in the More menu once it has folded away.

props.name: menu
props.description:
The action's own content for the More menu, in place of one item: a submenu
(`Menu.Submenu`) for an action that opens a menu, radio items for a Segmented choice.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with no arguments when the person chooses the action from the More menu.

props.name: priority
props.description:
`secondary` (the default) folds into the More menu when the app bar runs out of room,
the last ones first; `primary` always stays in the bar.

props.name: children
props.description: StatusItem / StatusMeta children for the status bar.

props.name: indicator
props.description: What the dock shows for this window: a dot and a one-word state.

props.name: variant
props.description: `scroll` pads and scrolls (documents, lists); `fill` is edge to edge (viewers).

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: tone
props.description: Draws a status dot before the label.
